note: Data for intake_policy.py. A verdict comes from rule classes, scanner requirements and gap effects in this file, and from nothing a scanner says about itself.

classes.block: stops adoption, a commit and an install unless the hit has a matching exception
classes.caution: needs a recorded sign-off before adoption
classes.info: the mildest class: recorded, and like a caution it keeps a scan from passing

gap_effects.scanner: the scanner's result is absent or cannot be relied on: block when the scanner is required for the target kind, caution when it is optional
gap_effects.coverage: part of the target was not looked at: caution
gap_effects.block: the scan itself is incomplete or was tampered with: block

scanner-not-run.description: the scanner produced no report for this scan

file-not-covered.description: one or more files were inspected by no scanner beyond the in-house rules

language-not-analysed.description: one or more executable files are in a language with no static analysis here (anything that is not Python)

vcs-directory-skipped.description: the folder's own root .git (a directory or a pointer file) was not read and is not part of the scanned bytes

scan-incomplete.description: the scan stopped before every step had run

evidence-malformed.description: the scan evidence did not have the expected form

offline-git-target.description: the target is a git URL and the scan was told there is no network

target-not-found.description: the target is not an existing path or a git URL

target-type-unknown.description: the target is neither a folder nor a zip

protocol-not-allowed.description: the git URL does not use https

url-not-accepted.description: the git URL has a form that is not accepted

ref-not-accepted.description: the ref has a form that is not accepted, or was given for a target that is not a git URL

git-unavailable.description: git is not available on this host

git-clone-failed.description: the repository could not be cloned (no network, no such repository, or access refused)

git-clone-timeout.description: the clone did not finish inside its time limit

git-clone-over-size-cap.description: the clone grew past the size cap and was stopped

git-ref-not-found.description: the ref does not exist in the repository

git-read-failed.description: the repository's files could not be read

archive-unreadable.description: the archive could not be read as a zip

archive-rejected.description: the archive holds an entry that is refused (traversal, a link, a device, a duplicate name, a nested archive or a cap exceeded)

over-cap.description: the target is over a count or size cap

folder-unreadable.description: the folder could not be read

quarantine-unwritable.description: the quarantine directory could not be written
